title: Dense Supervision, Sparse Updates: On the Sparsity and Geometry of On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2606.13657v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently become a prominent post-training recipe by combining two desirable ingredients: on-policy student-generated trajectories and dense token-level teacher supervision. Yet how this hybrid training regime shapes a model remains poorly understood. We characterize the sparsity and geometry of OPD parameter updates across several language and vision-language model pairs and application settings. OPD updates are small and coordinate-sparse, while remaining distributed across layers and modules. This sparse support is operationally meaningful: masked training on the discovered subnetwork nearly recovers full-training performance. At the matrix level, the updates are numerically full-rank but spectrally concentrated. Their visible supports avoid coordinates emphasized by the source's principal structure and favor low-magnitude source coordinates, while the source singular-value spectra change little. To

translated_title: 稠密监督，稀疏更新：论在策略蒸馏的稀疏性与几何特性
translated_abstract: 在策略蒸馏已成为一种突出的后训练方法，它结合了两个理想要素：在策略的学生模型生成轨迹以及稠密的词元级教师监督。然而，这种混合训练机制如何塑造模型仍知之甚少。我们在多个语言和视觉-语言模型对以及多种应用场景中，刻画了OPD参数更新的稀疏性与几何特性。研究发现，OPD更新幅度小且坐标稀疏，同时仍分布在各层和各模块之中。这种稀疏支撑在操作上具有重要意义：仅在所发现的子网络上进行掩码训练，即可几乎恢复完整训练的性能。在矩阵层面，这些更新在数值上是满秩的，但谱上高度集中。其可见支撑避开了源模型主结构所强调的坐标，而偏向低幅值的源坐标，同时源模型的奇异值谱几乎保持不变。
tldr: 本文系统刻画了在策略蒸馏参数更新的稀疏性与几何结构，发现其更新幅度小且坐标稀疏，仅在发现的关键子网络上训练即可几乎恢复完整性能，且更新避开源模型主结构方向、偏向低幅值坐标。
